name: caption
description: Auto-captioning with LLMs/JoyCaption and ComfyUI custom workflow nodes. Captioning GGUF models can be downloaded from HuggingFace via the Caption Models settings page.
author: DeeplabSystems

volumes.description: ComfyUI installation folder. In Docker mode this folder must contain main.py so the Caption Models page can install nodes into custom_nodes.
Directory for captioning models (GGUF + mmproj). Point this at your LM Studio models folder to reuse existing GGUFs — files downloaded from the Caption Models page land here too
